title: Smooth Hotbar
description: Vanilla hotbar without the annoying noise.
body:
# ⚡Tired of that annoying sand texture in the hotbar?


I suddenly noticed that the default **Minecraft hotbar has a pixelated sand texture hidden in its semi-transparent background**, and I couldn't unsee it.


It drove me crazy, so I decided to jump into Paint.NET and fix it myself. This simple resource pack removes that annoying pixel noise, replacing it with a completely **smooth**, **flat**, and **clean** _**vanilla-style**_ gray background.


### 🔍 Side-by-Side Comparison
![Comparation with and withouth the resource pack.](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/ebd48d1668d5b8ef24f985dd4edeaf013c04ebf5.png)
*(Look closely at the background of the hotbar slots against the dark blocks)*
*   **Vanilla:** Annoying pixelated, grainy texture inherited from old sand sprites, puff who would enjoy that.
*   **Smooth Hotbar:** Clean, matte, chad and uniform solid gray. Pure visual peace like a real sigma. (please help)


### 🎯 Features
*   **100% Faithful Layout:** Keeps the exact same borders, icons, and native dimensions. No weird redesigns for PVP or something similar.
*   **Noise Reduction:** Eradicates the old sand pattern from your HUD entirely.
*   **Performance Friendly:** Extremely lightweight. It won't affect your FPS at all, because It's just two textures I mean- YES LIGHTWEIGHT.


### 🛠️ How to Install
1. Download the .zip file.
2. Open Minecraft and go to **Options > Resource Packs > Open Pack Folder**.
3. Drag and drop the downloaded file inside.
4. Activate it by moving it to the right column and press **Done**!
